LESSON: DANCE

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Dance. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: which dance is • Learners watch relevant 2. Why do people dance?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify various occasions during which dance is performed in the society, recordings of different dances
2. develop an awareness of body from ICT devices for experience parts for their appropriate use in dance,
3. apply body movements that are part of daily experience in a variety of ways in dance for self-expression and enjoyment,
4. respond with movement to sound/music in a variety of ways for enjoyment, e) apply locomotor and non- locomotor/axial movements in sweeping motion) in dance creating own dance for enjoyment, f) observe basic elements of dance while dancing to enhance performance, g) take precautions during dance for own and others safety, h) practice etiquette during dance for own and others respect, i) use dance to express feelings and ideas for self-expression. cooperation and teamwork stimuli

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dance.
2. Explain Dance to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dance.
4. Show that you can: identify various occasions during which dance is performed in the society, recordings of different dances
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dance. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: which dance is • Learners watch relevant 2. Why do people dance?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. develop an awareness of body from ICT devices for experience parts for their appropriate use in dance,

4. respond with movement to sound/music in a variety of ways for enjoyment, e) apply locomotor and non- locomotor/axial movements in sweeping motion) in dance creating own dance for enjoyment, f) observe basic elements of dance while dancing to enhance performance, g) take precautions during dance for own and others safety, h) practice etiquette during dance for own and others respect, i) use dance to express feelings and ideas for self-expression. cooperation and teamwork stimuli
